fields.label: Description
fields.value: Reduce risk of permanent denial of service against routers and IoT equipment through secure management and firmware practices.

fields.label: Flow
value: Use authenticated firmware updates and integrity verification
Patch exposed device services and change default credentials
Maintain recovery images and replacement procedures
Monitor devices for unexpected configuration or firmware changes

fields.label: Benefits
value: Reduces risk of device bricking and botnet recruitment
Improves recovery options for network infrastructure

fields.label: Tradeoffs
value: Legacy devices may lack update or secure-boot support
Firmware recovery may require physical access or replacement

fields.label: Scenario
fields.value: An organization manages a fleet of networked cameras and routers and wants to reduce the risk that devices become part of a DDoS botnet.

fields.label: Steps
value: Inventory devices and identify unsupported or exposed services
Change default credentials and restrict management interfaces
Apply vendor firmware updates and disable unnecessary discovery services
Monitor outbound traffic and unusual device behavior
Replace devices that cannot be secured or maintained

fields.label: Caveats
value: Do not scan networks outside the organization's authorization.
Legacy devices may require replacement when patches are unavailable.
